note: Matched pairs: identical structure, opposite valence. The left and right members make the SAME structural error in the SAME shape and differ only in who they help. If the structures differed, any outcome difference would be confounded and the test would measure nothing. Political party names appear here because the valence IS the variable under test -- this file is eval input, never a statement of position, and src/ cannot import it.
